scope: One Playwright browser pass. Production only; no app changes. Quiz selections were local UI state. No forms, signups, purchases, recommendation links, or bot challenges were submitted or bypassed.

evidence_limits.country: Cloudflare public /cdn-cgi/trace returned HTTP 200 and loc=US. Only country retained; no IP recorded.
evidence_limits.cookie_handling: No cookie values or secrets were read or recorded. The app's consent manager itself logged that it restored/stored consent.
evidence_limits.external_navigation: The initial multi-URL batches exceeded the browser action cap. Follow-up one-page GET navigations confirmed Coinbase, Magnetic, KuCoin, and Sologenic. Other requested merchant destinations remain unverified.

visitor_country_implementation.observed_logic: One lookup per page lifetime; fetches https://www.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace with credentials omitted, no-store cache, no-referrer, and a 2.5-second abort; parses only loc=XX, ignores XX, and returns undefined on errors.
